layout: frame-major, then screen-row-major; x left to right; y top to bottom (+1 to -1)
encoding: base64 uint8; field value = min + byte / 255 * (max - min)
maskEncoding: base64 uint8; 1 = source finite node, 0 = transparent outside source domain

area.label: Normalized cell area
area.normalization: a/a0; a0=1; dimensionless normalized mean cell area

myosin.label: Myosin
myosin.normalization: Dimensionless model myosin; not a calibrated concentration

provenance.kind: archived numerical solution; no solver rerun
provenance.sourcePrecision: float32 fields; float64 coordinates and time
provenance.temporalSampling: Every tenth stored state, including 0, 7.5 and 15 h; no temporal interpolation.
provenance.spatialSampling: Nearest source nodes: round(linspace(0,99,80)); no averaging or synthetic field values.
provenance.domainNote: The archived finite-node mask is preserved. Source coordinate spacing is 2/99 while solver dxy is 0.02; some finite boundary nodes slightly exceed radius 1. The displayed domain is fixed, not a moving tissue boundary.
